note: sneed's race stats (2026-11-19, docs/design/races.md). Numbers are sneed's, not RimWorld's.

label: quick learner
description: Baseline humans pick up skills a fifth faster.

label: extreme thermal resistance
description: Heat, cold and fire do a tenth of the harm, and no heat injury comes until it is 100 C past what others bear.

label: orc hardiness
description: A tenth more hit points and blood, so every blood-loss stage comes later.

label: orc slowness
description: Learns and works a tenth slower.

label: drow dark vision
description: Sees in the dark: no slower there, works a tenth faster in it, and never feels cooped up underground.

label: sunlight sensitivity
description: Outdoors while the sun is up: aims and works a tenth worse.

label: nocturnal
description: Joins with a night schedule: asleep through the day, up and working at night. The schedule can be changed.

label: drow skin
description: Dark skin with a purple cast.

label: cat leap
description: Jumps twice as high and climbs walls twice as fast.

label: cat landing
description: Lands on its feet: a fifth less damage from falls and collapses.

label: cat fragility
description: Every penalty is a third worse: pain, lost capacities, limb slows, bad moods, tiredness and hunger.

label: cat ears and tail
description: Cat ears, a furred tail and small claws.
